old_findings.note: Each GAS read is now bound once where it executes. handleOps: '_194 = gas_remaining' before the innerHandleOp call (1481/1514); _244, _257 and _275 after it, used in the deposit SSTORE and the event (actualGas '_194 - _244 + _252 + _257 - _275'). The same holds in handleAggregatedOps (_572 before 3275), simulateHandleOp (_408 before 2257), innerHandleOp (_2 after decoding; _83 and _92 in _handlePostOp) and simulateValidation (AA41 check '_52 - _111').
actualGasCost is still distributed over the GAS terms ('_194 * _270 - _244 * _270 + _252 * _270 + _257 * _270 - _270 * _275'), and actualGas is unnamed.

regressions.decompiled: _52 = gas_remaining / static call address(cd[..aggregator..]) with: gas _52
regressions.old: static call address(cd[..aggregator..]) with: gas gas_remaining
regressions.source: EntryPoint.sol handleAggregatedOps: try aggregator.validateSignatures(ops, opa.signature) {} catch { revert SignatureValidationFailed(address(aggregator)); }
regressions.issue: A GAS read used once, as the gas argument of the call right after it, is bound to a temporary. The other 14 calls keep 'gas gas_remaining' inline.
regressions.rule: Inline a GAS binding into its only use when no instruction with an effect lies between the read and that use.
regressions.verified: reading only (_52 has no other use)

new_findings.issue: The 79 FailedOp reverts are now named (they were 'revert with mem[_N len 4], ...'). But a reason shorter than 32 bytes still prints as offset, length and a hex word. 32-byte reasons print as text ('AA51 prefund below actualGasCost').
new_findings.rule: A string argument whose data is a constant word, with its first len bytes printable and the rest zero, prints as a string literal of length len.

improvements: The GAS fix repairs the gas accounting in all five functions that had it, and the stray '_1 = gas_remaining' lines are gone. All 79 FailedOp reverts and ExecutionResult are decoded, and the AA90/91/93/94/96 Error reverts print as strings. Failure branches are now one-armed 'if bad: revert'. The postOp and innerHandleOp calls are named with decoded args (postOp's context is an Array). The userOpHash uses address(cd[..]) instead of a memory word. Dead copies into memory are dropped from innerHandleOp, which is 129 lines now 88. P4 fell from 14 to 4 lines, P2 from 13 to 9, and P6 is gone.
notes: Very long diff (5600 lines; handleOps moved ahead of unknownd6383f94). Reviewed by structure: each big function's old body was diffed against its new body, and the effect-bearing changed lines were grouped (calls, logs, storage, reverts, loops, GAS). Every GAS read in the five functions was checked against EntryPoint's preGas/gasleft() order. All loops are kept, including handleAggregatedOps' encoding loop (2592). innerHandleOp's def no longer lists _param6 and _param12, which it never reads; the other parameters keep their numbers. The deposit store in simulateHandleOp/handleAggregatedOps now prints the 'deposit overflow' SafeMath.add form, as handleOps does (neutral).
summary: The high round-1 GAS finding is fixed everywhere: preGas is read before the inner call, and each gasleft() is bound once. Custom errors and Error strings are decoded. Only a cosmetic regression (one GAS temp not inlined).
